scripts.predev: node -e "try{const v=require('vite/package.json').version;if(parseInt(v.split('.')[0],10)>=5){console.error('Vite '+v+' detected; requires v4.x. Please reinstall pinned v4.');process.exit(1)};console.log('[predev] vite',v)}catch(e){console.error('[predev] Unable to resolve local vite. Run npm install.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');try{const pj=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));const vite=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(require.resolve('vite/package.json'), 'utf8')).version;const ok=/^4\./.test(vite);if(!ok){console.error('[postinstall] FATAL: vite '+vite+' is not v4.x. Enforce vite@4.5.3, @vitejs/plugin-react@3.1.0, esbuild@0.19.12.');process.exit(1)};const p=path.join('node_modules','.vite');const d='.vite';try{fs.rmSync(p,{recursive:true,force:true});}catch{}try{fs.rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});}catch{}console.log('[postinstall] Verified vite',vite,'and purged .vite caches');}catch(e){console.error('[postinstall] Could not verify local vite. Run npm ci/install.');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.dev:purge-cache: node -e "try{require('fs').rmSync('node_modules/.vite',{recursive:true,force:true});require('fs').rmSync('.vite',{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('Purged Vite caches')}catch(e){console.warn('No Vite cache to purge')}" && node scripts/run-vite-local.js
